messages:
mira: Quick note from security review: the canary that persisted truncated request snippets is flagged again. We need an architecture that preserves triage speed but removes durable PII risk. Thoughts on an encrypted ephemeral-store + short redeem codes?

sam: I'm in favor of ephemeral only. Sketch: store encrypted blobs in object store (SSE + tenant-wrapped DEKs), ledger keeps only a pointer hash (sha256 of blob) + metadata. Generate a short redeem_code (signed compact JWT, expiry 2h) that can be redeemed to fetch and decrypt the blob via a backend flow that enforces RBAC + MFA. No freeform text in ledger rows.

elaine: Agree on encrypted blobs. Two additions: (1) put a per-tenant quota on blob writes + redeem attempts to protect costs and abuse; (2) require backend to redact high-entropy tokens automatically before encrypting for tenants who opted for max-redaction.

tony: Console UX: we need to preserve one-click investigation. Proposal: a small "Request Inspect" button that creates a redeem_code and shows modal: "This access will be audited and expires in 2h. Confirm to continue." Show requester name, exact audit message. If the user doesn't have MFA, deny.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: telemetry-ephemeral-1 canary starting in eu-central-1. ci/7621 -> prod-canary.

mira: On correlation risk: ledger pointer hash plus route metadata can be used to correlate events if attackers have matching inputs. To mitigate, add a random nonce to the blob before hashing (stored only server-side) so identical requests across tenants won't produce same pointer. Also limit pointer retention to 90d and rotate salts quarterly.

sam: Implementation sketch (pseudo):

```
nonce = crypto.random(16)
cleaned = redact_high_risk(user_payload)
blob = nonce || cleaned
blob_key = kms.generate_data_key(tenant_kms)
encrypted_blob = aes_gcm_encrypt(blob, blob_key.plain)
store_s3(encrypted_blob, s3_path)
pointer = sha256(s3_path || nonce || tenant_salt)
redeem_code = jwt_sign({kid, ptr:pointer, exp:now+2h}, service_signing_key)
ledger.insert({pointer, route, sample_reason, ptr_meta_tags})
```

elaine: For key management: use tenant-specific DEKs wrapped by our master-KMS. On DSAR, we can either delete blobs or rotate/wrap old keys so tokens can't be decrypted. Need policy for whether to permanently delete or to keep encrypted blobs but rotate keys; DSAR requests will likely demand deletion.

ton y: UX flow for DSAR: surface a toggle in tenant settings to 'auto-delete inspect blobs on DSAR' vs 'retain encrypted (non-decryptable) for audit'. Default to delete for EU tenants. Also show last-redeem timestamp in tenant activity.

elaine: Quotas: propose two controls per-tenant: write_quota (blobs/hour) and redeem_quota (redeems/hour). Enforcement at write/redeem API boundary -> return 429 + metric telemetry.inspect.quota.reject and increment telemetry.inspect.quota.blocked. Also add a soft-throttle that will respond with 202 and queue for low-priority processing if burst exceeded.

sam: Telemetry/metrics plan: emit telemetry.inspect.blob.write, telemetry.inspect.blob.encrypted.size, telemetry.inspect.redeem.success, telemetry.inspect.redeem.denied, telemetry.inspect.quota.exceeded. Add SLI: percent of successful redeems with latency < 1s.

mira: Rollout: feature-flag behind org opt-in. Start with 5 pilot tenants (support + 2 internal tenants) for 2 weeks. Validate: no ledger PII, quotas working, DSAR deletion tested, audit rows present per redeem. Then widen to 50 tenants, then account-wide default off for hosted.

ops-bot: infra-bot: created infra stack telemetry-ephemeral-store-v1 in eu-central-1 and us-west-2.

elaine: Auditing: every redeem must create an immutable audit row: {redeemer, redeem_code_kid, pointer, timestamp, reason, ip, console_session_id}. Store audit rows in WORM storage with separate retention policy (7 years for enterprise by request).

sam: Edge-case: attachments and embeddings  we have binary attachments in requests, redact or refuse writes by default. For embeddings we should never store raw text; instead store fingerprint and embedding vector only.\n
mira: Action items: Sam - PR for ledger schema + redeem_service endpoints + metrics. Elaine - quota service knobs + DSAR playbook and load sim. Tony - modal copy + MFA enforcement UX. Ops - KMS/dek plan and infra stack. I'll open RFC and schedule 30m sync tomorrow 10:00.

ton y: UI copy draft: "Inspect data is ephemeral and encrypted. Access attempts are logged and audited. By requesting, you confirm you are authorized to view sensitive data." Small CTA: "Request Inspect" + confirmation checkbox "I will not copy data to external systems."

mira: One more: make sure the redeem_code is single-use (redeem invalidates it) and we store redeem_count in ledger pointer metadata (but not who viewed the blob beyond the audit row).

sam: I'll add single-use nonce and make redeem endpoint a transaction that deletes the blob key after successful decrypt to enforce single-use.

elaine: Cost estimate: ephemeral storage + KMS calls will add overhead. I'll run a 72h cost sim for pilot tenants and post numbers.

mira: Thanks team. Tagging @ops-bot for runbook + @infra for the stack. Moving to pinned checklist. :white_check_mark:
